mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_code AS permissionCode, p.permission_name AS permissionName, p.resource_type AS resourceType, p.resource_path AS resourcePath, p.status FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT scope_type AS scopeType, scope_value AS scopeValue FROM sys_data_scope WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT ds.scope_type AS scopeType, ds.scope_value AS scopeValue FROM sys_data_scope ds JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = ds.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
